business_problem: AXA Switzerland needed to move beyond fragmented legacy insurance systems, shorten slow analytics cycles, and build a cloud-native foundation that could support new AI-driven customer experiences, risk insights, and application modernization.
solution_summary: AXA Switzerland used Google Cloud to build a cloud-native analytics and AI foundation that could support both enterprise modernization and new customer-facing insurance services. BigQuery became the central data platform, bringing CRM, ERP, ecommerce, and operational information together in one place so teams could run business-critical queries in seconds or minutes instead of waiting through weekend batch cycles. On top of that data layer, AXA uses Vertex AI for machine-learning workflows and Cloud Run to deploy serverless applications that operationalize new models and digital services. The combination gives AXA a cleaner path from enterprise data migration to experimentation with natural-language interactions and more personalized protection workflows. Rather than treating AI as a side project, AXA anchored its broader digital-transformation program in a governed Google Cloud stack that ties data processing, model execution, and application delivery together.
